text:
```yaml
name: Test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 'stable'
          check-latest: true
          cache: true

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./...
```
